_comment: Deterministic fixture for the plugin safety harness. Written before the core 3.5.0 mixin adoption as its byte-for-byte baseline. Seeds the season cache (key ufc_scoreboard_schedule_2026, read by BaseUFCManager._fetch_ufc_api_data before any fetch) with four cards around the frozen 2026-03-10 18:00 UTC: two finals and a postponed bout on 2026-03-07 (Recent; the postponed one must not appear), a final outside the 14-day lookback, two scheduled bouts on 2026-03-14 (Upcoming) and one outside the 7-day lookahead. Every bout has a seeded odds entry -- a moneyline for Costa vs O'Brien, a no-odds marker for the rest -- so show_odds stays on without an odds request. display.use_short_date_format is on because the long form goes through the harness display manager's format_date_with_ordinal, whose %-d is a glibc extension: on Windows it raises and every bout fails to parse. Fighters carry no ESPN id, so no headshot is requested and the cards render without headshots, as they do for a fighter ESPN has none for. Live is not rendered: UFCLiveManager._fetch_data() -> _fetch_todays_games() is a direct ESPN call with no cache read, and the live manager is built and updated whatever show_live says. test_mode plus the huge live_update_interval keeps that update from fetching (under freeze_time, now - last_update stays below the interval); test_mode's built-in fight is only held, never drawn, because show_live is off; its two headshots are the one request a harness run still makes (BaseUFCManager.update prefetches them, and ESPN answers 404), and nothing rendered depends on it.
